entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say or enter your reason for calling.
Umm... return an item.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to... I think I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins. Order number... uh... 7... 8... 1... 1... 5... 4... 2.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

Oh, um... I don't really know. It's not broken or anything. It's just... a lot more complicated than I expected. The website made it look so simple. I'm just overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.
I understand it can be a bit much at first. It sounds like it's just not the right fit for you. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay... I hope it's not too late. I just feel so lost with this thing.
Alright, I've just pulled up our return policy details. It looks like you are well within the return window.
I am? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried.
Yes, our policy states that you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. Since you received it 27 days ago, we can definitely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Wow, really? That's amazing. Thank you so much, Alex! That's such a relief.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That sounds perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've solved my problem!
Great to hear. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
